title: Voice-activity leak
blurb: Runs two concurrent WebRTC calls driven by one Web Audio oscillator (Call A clear, Call B cryptex) and polls RTCRtpReceiver.getSynchronizationSources().audioLevel to show identical app-visible RFC 6464 levels while cryptex removes them from the wire.
question: Does negotiating RFC 9335 cryptex keep RTCRtpReceiver.getSynchronizationSources().audioLevel working identically for the application while encrypting the RFC 6464 ssrc-audio-level header extension on the wire?
result: Verified in Chrome 153 headless with --enable-blink-features=RtcRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: both receivers rose from 0.014 to 0.631 on Talk and dropped back afterward, with Call A clear (via stripped answer because 'disable' is absent in 153) and Call B cryptex per SDP. Unflagged reports both calls clear. Full 'disable' Call A path awaits Chrome 160+.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (unflagged and --enable-blink-features=RtcRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy); not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: Chromium requires attaching the remote audio track to a muted <audio> sink before decoding frames and populating getSynchronizationSources().audioLevel
friction.repro: Receive a remote audio track on an RTCPeerConnection in Chrome 153 without wiring it to an <audio> element; getSynchronizationSources() stays empty or does not report live audioLevel changes.
friction.workaround: Attach the remote MediaStream to a hidden, muted <audio autoplay> element so the decoder pipeline runs without audible output.

friction.summary: SRTP wire header bytes (0xBEDE vs 0xC0DE profile) are not exposed to JavaScript, so pages cannot directly inspect encrypted wire packets
friction.repro: Attempt to inspect raw RTP header extension bytes from JS during an active WebRTC call; only negotiated SDP attributes (a=cryptex) and receiver metadata APIs are web-observable.
friction.workaround: Verify cryptex negotiation from localDescription.sdp and remoteDescription.sdp and enforce rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'require' when plaintext fallback is unacceptable.
